1: Allah ne Qayamat ke din ki qasam khayi jab log tamam jahanon ke Rubb ke saamne khade honge.
2: Us ne us paak nafs ki qasam khayi jo apne maalik ko nek aamaal mein kotahi par aur bure kaam karne par malamat karta hai. Us ne in dono cheezon ki qasam khayi ke woh logon ko hisaab aur badle ke liye zaroor dobara uthayega.
3: Kya insan samajhta hai ke main us ke marne ke baad us ki haddiyan dobara uthne ke liye jama na karoonga?!
4: Beshak main unhein jama karne ke saath us ki ungliyon ke poron ko bhi ek munasib soorat mein waise hi bahaal karne par qaadir hoon jaise woh the.
5: Lekin insan apne dobara uthne ke inkar se chahta hai ke aage bhi be-rok-tok gunah karta rahe.
6: Woh shubah ke saath Qayamat ke din ke baare mein poochhta hai: Woh kab hogi?
7: Jab nazar chundhiya jaayegi aur hairan hogi us waqt jab woh use dekhegi jis ka woh inkar karti thi.
8: Aur chaand ki roshni jaati rahegi.
9: Aur sooraj aur chaand jama kar diye jaayenge.
10: Gunahgaar shaks us din kahega: Bhaagne ki jagah kahan hai?!
11: Us din bhaagne ki koi jagah nahin aur koi aisi jagah nahin jis mein gunahgaar panaah le aur na koi aisi jagah jis mein woh hifazat talash kare.
12: Us din lautna aur thikana aap ke Rubb ki taraf hoga, aey Rasool, hisaab aur badle ke liye.
13: Us din insan ko un aamaal ke baare mein bataya jayega jo us ne aage bheje aur un ke baare mein jo us ne peeche chhode.
14: Balke insan khud apne khilaf gawah hai kyunke us ke aazaa us ke un gunahon ke baare mein us ke khilaf gawahi denge jo us ne kiye.
15: Chahe woh apne haqq mein bahas karne ke liye uzr pesh kare ke us ne koi burai nahin ki, yeh use faida na denge.
16: Apni zuban ko Quran ke saath jaldi se na hilayein, aey Rasool, is khauf se ke woh aap se nikal jayega.
17: Yeh mera kaam hai ke use aap ke seene mein jama karoon aur us ki tilawat aap ki zuban par qayam karoon.
18: Jab Jibreel (alaihis salaam) aap ke saamne us ki tilawat poori kar lein, to tawajjo dein aur us ke parhe jaane ko sunein.
19: Phir yeh mera kaam hai ke use aap ke liye khol kar bayan karoon.
20: Nahin, maamla aisa nahin jaisa tum ne dobara uthne ke na-mumkin hone ke baare mein daawa kiya. Tum jaante ho ke woh hasti jo tumhein pehli baar paida karne par qaadir thi tumhein tumhari maut ke baad dobara zinda karne se aajiz nahin. Lekin tumhare dobara uthne ke inkar ki wajah duniya ki is fani zindagi ki tumhari muhabbat hai.
21: Aur aakhirat ki zindagi se tumhari be-parwahi, jis ka raasta yeh hai ke farmanbardari ke woh kaam karo jin ka Allah ne tumhein hukm diya aur woh haraam kaam chhod do jin se us ne tumhein mana kiya.
22: Us din iman aur khush-naseebi walon ke chehre noor se chamakte honge.
23: Apne Rubb ko lazzat ke saath dekhte hue.
24: Us din kufr aur badnaseebi walon ke chehre tareek honge.
25: Unhein yaqeen hoga ke un par ek bada aur dard-naak azaab utarne wala hai.
26: Maamla aisa nahin jaisa mushrikon ne samjha, ke unhein marne par azaab na diya jayega. Jab un mein se kisi ki rooh us ke seene ke oopri hisse tak pahunchti hai.
27: Aur log ek doosre se kehte hain: Kaun is shaks ko shifa de sakta hai, shayad use ilaaj mil jaaye?!
28: Takleef mein pada shaks us waqt yaqeen kar lega ke yeh maut ke zariye duniya se judai hai.
29: Us waqt mushkilein jama ho jaayengi jab duniya khatm hoti hai aur aakhirat shuru hoti hai.
30: Jab yeh ho jayega, to murde ko us ke Rubb ki taraf haanka jayega.
31: Kafir ne us ko qabool na kiya jo us ka Rasool us ke paas laaya, aur na us ne Allah se dua ki, woh paak hai.
32: Balke us ne us ko jhutlaya jo us ka Rasool us ke paas laaya aur us se munh pher liya.
33: Phir yeh kafir apne ghar walon ki taraf gaya, ghuroor se akarte hue chalta hua.
34: Pas Allah ne kafir ko daraya ke us ka azaab us ke qareeb aa gaya.
35: Phir us ne zor dene ke liye yeh baat dohrayi aur farmaya: 'Phir, woh tujh par zyada se zyada qareeb aa raha hai.'
36: Kya insan samajhta hai ke Allah use bekar chhod dega, us par koi ahkam lazim kiye bagair?
37: Kya yeh insan ek din rehm mein daala gaya ek nutfa na tha?
38: Us ke baad woh jama hua khoon ka ek tukda tha. Phir Allah ne use paida kiya aur us ki soorat munasib banayi.
39: Phir us ne us ki jins ki do qismein banayin: nar aur maada?!
40: Kya woh hasti, jis ne insan ko ek boond se, phir ek jame hue khoon se paida kiya, murdon ko hisaab aur badle ke liye dobara zinda karne par qaadir nahin?! Beshak woh is par qaadir hai.
